owner_text: Hello, Henrietta Vance, senior partner at Kestrel Fitness Partners, and yes, the name is a long story. Forgive me for launching in: the deadline crunch in January and chasing missing documents are what keep me awake.
I'll attach the engagement checklist our juniors use, it saves me explaining.
We're accountants: tax returns, bookkeeping, year-end accounts for around 300 small firms and sole traders. One office.
People email mostly, phone sometimes, and some use the client portal. Roughly 14 a day, ten minutes to read and answer each, five more to type it up.
Hang on, HR emailed this morning to say eighteen with the trainees.
Sixteen. The trainees are on placement, not employees.
And requests get lost in the shared mailbox. When it goes wrong we miss things, run late or file a wrong figure.
Document chasing, request logging, deadline reminders; fewer errors is the point. Our software exports CSV.
We hold tax numbers, bank details and clients' home addresses. Filing deadlines two days out and tax office letters are urgent.
No budget yet. Within six months, I'd hope.
